fees.note: $17 per permit (one permit covers size and weight).

Per ton (or major fraction) over legal, rate by Arkansas miles: <=100 mi $8; 101-150 $10; 151-200 $12; 201-250 $14; 251+ $16 (27 CAR pt. 111 Appendix). 'major fraction' rounding is modeled as round-up. Mobile construction equipment has a lower separate chart.

restrictions.text: Daylight only (sunrise to sunset per NOAA). Weekend moves allowed. No moves on New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas; if the holiday is observed on a Friday or Monday, no moves on the adjoining weekend. No travel with visibility under 500 ft or in hazardous weather; may be restricted in winds over 20 knots. Keep 1,000 ft from other oversize loads.
Little Rock curfew: no oversize moves 7:00-9:00 a.m. and 4:00-6:00 p.m. on I-30 (MM 138-143), I-40 (MM 151-155) and all of I-630 (proposed 2026 rule limits this to Monday-Friday).

restrictions.when: Over 18' wide, on interstates and freeways
restrictions.text: Interstate permits are limited to 18 ft overall width (20 ft on other highways).

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

sources.title: ArDOT Permit Rules 2023 for the Movement of Oversize and Overweight Vehicles on the Arkansas State Highway System
Code of Arkansas Rules 27 CAR pt. 111 Appendix (Overweight Fee Chart)
Proposed Rulemaking 27 CAR pt. 111 Oversize/Overweight Permits (draft, published 3/18/2026)

notes: Legal: 8'6" wide, 14' high, 80,000 lb gross on 5+ axles; trailer up to 53'6" with no overall limit (a longer trailer is legal if overall <= 60'). Front overhang over 3' needs a permit; no permit over 20' front overhang.

Overweight-only loads (legal width/height/length) may move continuously incl. nights, weekends and holidays; overlength-only loads up to 90' overall may move 24/7; over 90' daylight and non-holidays only.

Escorts on non-interstate roads modeled as two-lane rules; 4+ lane divided highways follow the interstate rule (1 rear escort over 14' wide). Length 100'+: 1 escort (rear on 4-lane, front elsewhere); over 115': front + rear on roads with fewer than 4 lanes.
Height over 17': written agreements with overhead utility/signal owners and their representatives may need to accompany the move.

Superload thresholds (gross 180,000+ lb, width over 16'6", length 100'+ overall, height 15'6"+) are issued at ArDOT discretion and may require engineering examinations; no fixed police-escort or route-survey trigger - AHP may require law enforcement escorts case by case.
Rules are being recodified as 27 CAR pt. 111 (proposed 2026); substance checked to be the same for fees, escorts, superloads and holidays.
